svg.font-family: SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SpeakWith status monitor — the floating mode panel
svg.desc: Vector recreation of the floating status monitor SpeakWith shows while the live-direct mic is held, with callouts for its parts, the five mode words and colours, the screen furniture it does not need, and the Dock badge fallback.
svg.text: The floating status monitor
A small pill that stays on top while the live-direct mic is held. It tells you the mode at a glance, from anywhere on the screen.

g.text: the app you are working in; the monitor floats above it
So you know whose badge this is when it is
the only thing of ours on screen.
Red, blue, indigo, orange, or green.
Optionally pulses while the mic is held.
The colour never stands alone: the word
beside the dot says the same thing.
Shown only when it adds something, for
example dictation into an open text field.
Optional. It answers the other question:
is the mic still hearing me?

svg.text: The five modes
A take is running and going
into your day document.
A take is running and being typed
into the app in front of you.
A take is running, and a shell
client is pulling the words.
Level mode standby: mic held,
a take starts when you speak up.
The mic is held and metering,
with no take running.
Listening is level mode: a hardware mute switch drops the level, so muting pauses the recorder and unmuting resumes it. No key, no click.
When more than one applies, the panel shows the highest: Voice pull, then Type into app, then Recording. Batch capture and Off show no panel at all.
Nothing else to keep on screen
The panel is its own small window. It takes no menu-bar slot, needs no Dock, and never takes keyboard focus. Drag it anywhere once; it stays there.
If you keep the Dock showing
The Dock badge is the fallback.
It reads REC while recording, TYPE while typing into another app, and a pause mark while listening.
macOS paints every Dock badge the same red, so it cannot colour-code the modes. Only the floating monitor can.
Direct download builds only. Settings, Dictation, Type into app: Show mode indicator, Pulse the mode indicator, Waveform in the mode indicator.
